## Mandatory Markdown Reading Order

Open this Index first, read the following documents in order, then inspect the assigned GitHub
Issue, current branch/diff, and only the task-specific module/constraint/runbook documents.

1. [Canonical Context and Language](../CONTEXT.md) — Learn the product thesis, canonical language, relationships, and truth hierarchy.
2. [Overall Design Baseline](architecture/top-level-design.md) — Understand the mission, controlled subsystems, interface baselines, observations, and lifecycle gates.
3. [钱学森 Skills](methodology/qian-systems-engineering.md) — Understand the composite systems-engineering, documentation-as-code, implementation-discipline, and D0-D3 correction model.
4. [Composite Engineering Baseline](governance/composite-engineering-baseline.md) — Apply authority, precedence, document classes, implementation gates, verification, and handoff as one baseline.
5. [VisePanda V2 Frozen Product Baseline](planning/visepanda-v2-final-architecture.md) — Read the frozen product, commercial, architecture, roadmap, and anti-goal baseline.
6. [VisePanda V2 Project Review — 2026-07-10](planning/visepanda-v2-project-review-2026-07-10.md) — Compare the frozen target with the latest evidence-based implementation audit.
7. [Phase 0/1 Dependency Graph](governance/phase-0-1-dependency-graph.md) — Resolve canonical ownership, dependencies, trigger gates, and historical migrations before taking an Issue.
8. [Module Guide](modules/README.md) — Choose the owning module document and inspect its actual maturity before editing.
9. [Constraint Guide](constraints/README.md) — Load mandatory architecture, coding, business, permission, deployment, and iteration constraints.
10. [Karpathy Coding Discipline](constraints/karpathy-guidelines.md) — Apply explicit assumptions, minimum sufficient design, surgical diffs, and step-to-check verification.
11. [ADR Index](adr/README.md) — Check accepted decisions before changing architecture, contracts, or commercial semantics.
12. [Runbook Index](runbooks/README.md) — Read the relevant procedure before deployment, migration, AI, knowledge, commerce, or Human Task operations.
13. [Operator Action Register](governance/operator-action-register.md) — Check unresolved third-party, legal, secret, deployment, and production-evidence actions before claiming an external capability is live.

The handoff snapshot and reading order are generated from [`handoff.json`](handoff.json). Every
repository change must update that file and regenerate this Index.

## Maintenance

- Add, move, archive, or reclassify a document in `docs/manifest.json`.
- Update `docs/handoff.json` for every repository change, including docs-only changes.
- Run `pnpm docs:index` after registry changes.
- Run `pnpm docs:check` for coverage, metadata, headings, links, and freshness.
- Run `pnpm docs:impact -- --base <git-ref>` to verify code-to-document synchronization.
